name: comp-296
title: Live Event Notification
description: A notification for an upcoming live event. A ringed radio-wave badge leads into a short countdown and a date, with a light reminder button and an X to close.
use: A site wants to flag an upcoming live event and offer a reminder sign-up.
avoid: All the copy is fixed and both buttons are inert, so real reminders need wiring.
a11y: The close cross is named and both buttons focus, but neither has an action and the card has no live-region role. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bordered rounded strip with a soft shadow holds a circular outlined badge with a radio icon, a bold countdown line over a small grey date, a pale filled Notify me button and a grey close cross at the right.
behaves: Only hover states move: the button and the close cross shade when pointed at. Clicking the cross or the button has no effect, so the card stays put.
customise: The countdown, date and button wording are written in the file; icon, badge and width are fixed, and the component takes no props.
weight: light: A single card with one icon and two buttons; only hover fades run.
